0022600172.text: The Heat (2-4, fourth in the Southeast and one game back, 10th in the East) visit on a two-game winning streak after going 1-1 on the road, though Tim Hardaway Jr. is day-to-day with a personal reason and is a game-time decision after averaging 6.2 points in 18.2 minutes this season. The Lakers (4-2, first in the Pacific and seventh in the West) come in on a one-game losing streak, and Adou Thiero (knee inflammation) and Ziaire Williams (foot) are both out. The teams have no games yet in the 2026-27 season series, while Miami lost 0-2 to Los Angeles in 2025-26, most recently 134-126 in Miami on March 19, 2026.
